feature_syntax: '<source>' or '<source>:<sub>' where sub is an obs field name, a column name of the source (names_* arrays), or a dotted meta.json key path for source 'meta'. Anything not explicitly allowed is rejected (whitelist).

runtime_observation.description: what env.step/reset return to the policy

action_history.description: the controller's own past (and candidate) actions; commanded values and their deterministic effective transform

public_metadata.description: static per-building metadata available to the deployed policy (create_building_meta_data or derived from it)

restricted.description: computable at run time only under extra assumptions; must be enabled explicitly

privileged_target.description: simulator internals / reward; training targets and auxiliary supervision only

privileged_episode.description: episode identity or absolute dates (reveal month/day/holidays or the scenario)

bookkeeping.description: collection artefacts with no physical meaning

obs.notes: All fields are observable but carry different lags (configs/sensor_alignment.json). Some fields are action echoes, so obs[t+1] must not be used as an input for transition t.

action_continuous.notes: a_{<t} as history; a_t.. as planned decision variables

effective_action.notes: src/effective_action.py: deterministic transform of the commanded action and run bits; no future observation used

baseline_continuous.notes: b_t is computable at run time only if the deployed controller runs the baseline internally; in the dataset it is conditioned on the perturbed history (audit section 7.4)

tank_state.notes: tank temperature equals the HWS sensor in obs (lag 1), other columns are internal

calendar.notes: month/day/is_workday are not observable; hour/minute/weekday must be derived from obs clock features instead

sim_timestamp.notes: absolute date reveals month and holidays

index.notes: window bookkeeping returned by AlignedWindows (episode id, t0)

notes.privileged: episode_start/episode_end reveal the month; boiler internals are simulator parameters (identical across all 30 configs, but not given to the policy)
notes.scenario/weather: weather station + index identify the climate trace; not available for hidden evaluation
notes.building: building id; forbidden as input (no memorisation of training buildings)
notes.schedule.holidays: public (create_building_meta_data). Empty in all 30 shipped scenarios; a list of dates cannot be matched without the current date, which is not observable
notes.verification: public_metadata is byte-identical across the 5 weather scenarios of each building (tests/test_runtime_features.py), so it carries no episode/date information
